biotools.summary: DNALONGBENCH is a benchmark suite designed to evaluate long-range DNA prediction tasks, covering areas like enhancer-target gene interaction and 3D genome organization. It provides a standardized resource for comparing deep learning models that account for long-range dependencies in DNA sequences.
